8 CFR Part 208

RIN 1615-AD18


Affirmative Asylum Referrals Without Interview

Correction

[[Page 55736]]


    Editorial note: This document is the only published correction 
to 2026-15190. Due to technical issues, documents numbered C1-2026-
15190 and C2-2026-15190 do not exist.

    In rule document 2026-15190 beginning on page 47101 in the issue of 
Tuesday, July 28, make the following change
